author: Inside Edition
description: Rob Reiner was allegedly working on a project about the assassination of John F. Kennedy Jr. when he and his wife, Michele, were murdered last year. Reiner co-hosted a podcast on the subject. On Tuesday, a book based on the podcast was released with a foreword written by Reiner before his death. This is believed to be the last project from the beloved director. The book coincides with renewed interest in the presidential assassination tied to the upcoming release of “November 1963.”
title: Was This Rob Reiner’s Last Project Before His Death?

author: Inside Edition
description: Nationwide jitters are intensifying Wednesday as we seek answers for what is being called “Bug-Mageddon.” On Capitol Hill Wednesday, members of Congress grilled officials from the Trump administration. Adding to the sense of crisis, Vice President JD Vance abruptly pulled out of a high-powered conference in New York after he was called into urgent meetings in Washington. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is trying to reassure the nation.
title: What Caused All The Tech Outages?

author: Inside Edition
description: Inside Edition’s Alison Hall and fellow breast cancer survivor actress Olivia Munn made their way to Washington D.C. to push for legislation to make what’s known as the “Breast Cancer Risk Assessment Test” a routine part of health care. Hall’s breast cancer journey began two years ago. Like Munn, Hall underwent a double mastectomy with reconstruction. Hall and Munn met with Arizona senator Mark Kelly, who is introducing the bi-partisan bill that he calls the  “Know Your Risk Act.”
title: Inside Edition’s Alison Hall Goes To Washington D.C.

author: Inside Edition
description: Fear is gripping the nation over a cascade of tech outages disrupting daily life. Inside Edition went shopping for emergency supplies with Desiree Ramos Reiner of the American Red Cross. Ramos Reiner gave tips like getting gallons of water and canned food. She also gave tips on what to get from the hardware store. You should also stock up on hygiene products and medication. The Federal Emergency Management Agency also advises people to print hard copies of important documents.
title: How Do You Prepare For A Cyber Disaster?

author: Inside Edition
description: It's not as old as the holiday itself, but the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is celebrating a milestone this year: an entire century of kicking off the holiday season with its iconic giant balloons. People who put the parade together say this year will pay homage to its history. All of the characters are being prepped and brought to life at Macy's warehouse in New Jersey. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Macy's Prepares Floats And Balloons For 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade

author: Inside Edition
description: A Florida man has been arrested after allegedly sending a card smeared with peanut butter to a woman with severe allergies, police said. Joseph Cancellare faces charges of aggravated battery with a deadly weapon and culpable negligence. Cancellare blamed the unidentified woman, who was his ex-wife's best friend, for the couple's divorce, police said. “Though peanut butter is not often used as a deadly weapon, Joseph used it as one in this case,” a court document stated.
title: Man Arrested After Mailing Peanut Butter-Laced Card To Allergic Woman: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: A father and child were trapped in a condo filled with smoke. It happened in Michigan, where officers from the Shelby Township Police Department were first on the scene to the home on fire.  People alerted officers to the missing family members. Once those people were led to safety, an officer went inside a smoky hallway in search of the father and son. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Father And Son Rescued From House Fire By Officer

author: Inside Edition
description: At the South Carolina Department of Natural Resources, the K-9s have very serious jobs. They are highly skilled and certified in area searches, obedience, tracking, trailing, and wildlife detection. But these hard-working pups definitely let their hair down for the company's recent picture day, and chaotic doesn't even describe how the sessions went. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: K-9 Photo Day Turns Into Complete Chaos

author: Inside Edition
description: Army veteran Ryan Walton recounts the day in 2009 when thirteen people were killed and 30 were injured in a mass shooting at Fort Hood.
title: Fort Hood Shooting Survivor Remembers That Terrible Day #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: If you're feeling a little on edge today, you're not alone. Planes were grounded last Friday, and a software glitch caused banking snafus on Monday. And now, this: millions coast to coast were convinced today that something really bad was going to happen, as an emergency alert was sent out across the airwaves as part of a test by the FEMA. Additionally, businesses that sell items targeted to doomsday preppers say they are seeing a 60% to 70% increase in sales. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian tells us what's going on.
title: Why America Has The Jitters
